pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large polygonal and sub-rectangular dark regions with rounded vertices. Edges exhibit moderately smooth pixel gradients. Patch area is significantly larger than the inter-patch negative space.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-cream pathways of relatively uniform pixel thickness. Junction nodes consist primarily of tri-radial and quadri-radial intersections forming a stable tessellation.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the upper neck, created by short, dark-pigmented bristles.
